sources.version: arXiv:2008.07003v3. Source-level comparison is specifically to the supplied TeX archive, whose SHA-256 is recorded below.
inspected: Supplied extraction: §1.1 promise and quantum proposition; §1.2 main results; selected §1.3 overview and independent-work discussion (including lines 149–235); §5.4, lines 1006–1023.

Primary arXiv abstract/comments/version metadata inspected online.
supports: Bansal–Sinha establish the explicit Walsh k-Forrelation lower bound; their paper distinguishes SSW’s independent random-orthogonal rorrelation result.
The supplied version’s final summation lines are the actual source of the record’s logarithm/exponent comparison. The record’s source hash and cited TeX lines agree with the supplied archive.
The original covariance-interpolation method is a useful contrast for describing the record’s fixed Gaussian law and first-block sign-bias interpolation.
limitations: Sections 3–4 were not read in full. The source-level check is version-specific and does not establish that the cited paper’s main theorem is false. No claim is made about all subsequent corrected presentations or journal versions.
